# Mindright

> > Mindright is a clinical psychology practice in Bondi Junction offering evidence-based mental health services including ADHD/ASD assessment, telehealth, and therapeutic interventions.

Mindright provides comprehensive mental health services through a team of experienced clinical psychologists in Bondi Junction, Sydney, with both in-person and telehealth options. The practice specializes in neurodevelopmental assessment, psychological therapy using evidence-based approaches, and treatment of anxiety, depression, and other mental health conditions.

## Key Topics

- ADHD assessment and diagnosis
- ASD assessment and diagnosis
- Clinical psychology
- CBT (Cognitive Behavioral Therapy)
- ACT (Acceptance and Commitment Therapy)
- Mindfulness-based therapy
- Telehealth consultations
- Bondi Junction clinic
- Anxiety and depression treatment
- Evidence-based psychological therapy
- Neurodevelopmental assessment
- Mental health services
- Dr Michelle Pritchard
- Dr Cecilia Minogue
- Appointment booking

- [Difficulties We Work With](https://www.mindright.com.au/difficulties-we-work-with): Overview of mental health conditions and psychological difficulties Mindright treats

- [Therapeutic Approaches](https://www.mindright.com.au/therapeutic-approaches): Mindright's therapeutic methods including ACT, CBT, and mindfulness-based approaches
